title: PWO proteins are associated with PRC2 since their emergence in vascular plants.
authors: Khan, Ahamed; Haider, Saqlain; Sharaf, Abdoallah; Kusova, Alzbeta; Skalak, Jan; Jourdain, Claire; Rennie, Martin; Schrumpfova, Petra Prochazkova; Hejatko, Jan; Schubert, Daniel; Farrona, Sara; Mozgova, Iva
one_liner_zh: 该文研究PWO蛋白与PRC2复合物的进化及互作，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，且方法以实验和AlphaFold结构预测为主，缺乏TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The Polycomb repressive complex 2 (PRC2), a conserved histone methyltransferase complex, plays a central role in transcriptional silencing across eukaryotes. Here, we investigate the evolution of PWWP-DOMAIN INTERACTORS OF POLYCOMBS (PWOs), which interact with PRC2, and examine the conservation of the PWOs-PRC2 interaction across plant evolution by comparing orthologs from the lycophyte Selaginella moellendorffii (Sm) and the flowering plant Arabidopsis thaliana (Arabidopsis; At). Phylogenetic data traced the presence of PWO proteins across plant lineages, while protein-protein interaction assays and AlphaFold predictions assessed PWO-PRC2 interactions and structural conservation. Functional complementation assays confirmed PWOs' conserved functions. PWO proteins are present in vascular plants but absent in bryophytes and green algae. The ancestral clade of PWO proteins includes the spikemoss Selaginella moellendorffii (Sm) PWO orthologs SmPWOa and SmPWOb. PWO proteins from vascular plants can interact with PRC2 components from multiple species, including bryophytes, which naturally lack PWOs. The PWO-PRC2 interaction is mediated by a conserved short C-motif. Functional and molecular assays further demonstrate that SmPWOs retain their conserved functions in Arabidopsis. Our data suggest an evolutionarily conserved role for PWOs in modulating PRC2 activity and emphasize how lineage-specific proteins associated with conserved chromatin-modifying complexes may shape epigenetic control mechanisms during evolution.
abstract_zh: 多梳抑制复合物2（PRC2），一种保守的组蛋白甲基转移酶复合物，在真核生物的转录沉默中发挥核心作用。在此，我们研究了与PRC2相互作用的PWWP结构域多梳互作因子（PWOs）的进化，并通过比较石松类植物卷柏（Selaginella moellendorffii，Sm）和开花植物拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana，拟南芥；At）中的直系同源物，考察了PWOs-PRC2相互作用在植物进化中的保守性。系统发育数据追踪了PWO蛋白在植物谱系中的存在，而蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用实验和AlphaFold预测评估了PWO-PRC2相互作用及结构保守性。功能互补实验确认了PWOs的保守功能。PWO蛋白存在于维管植物中，但在苔藓植物和绿藻中缺失。PWO蛋白的祖先分支包括卷柏（Selaginella moellendorffii，Sm）的PWO直系同源物SmPWOa和SmPWOb。来自维管植物的PWO蛋白能与多种物种（包括天然缺乏PWOs的苔藓植物）的PRC2组分相互作用。PWO-PRC2相互作用由保守的短C端基序介导。功能和分子实验进一步表明，SmPWOs在拟南芥中保留其保守功能。我们的数据表明，PWOs在调节PRC2活性中具有进化上保守的作用，并强调与保守染色质修饰复合物相关的谱系特异性蛋白可能如何在进化过程中塑造表观遗传控制机制。
